description: GSILIB is provided by Geospatial Information Authority of Japan. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Potential simulation use: Compare GNSS baseline and multipath-correction algorithms.
